summary: Iteration 356 - Unified Hybrid Endpoint /api/resource-availability VERIFIED. All 42 tests PASSED (16 new iter356 tests + 26 iter351/352 regression tests). The new hybrid endpoint correctly returns BOTH snapshot AND bookings_by_resource in a single request. Single Mongo query ensures no status drift. Legacy /api/resource-availability-snapshot remains as backwards-compat alias.

hybrid_endpoint_global.description: GET /api/resource-availability (no params) returns {snapshot: {...}, bookings_by_resource: {}} for ALL resources. Parent shows next_busy when children are booked.

hybrid_endpoint_scoped.description: GET /api/resource-availability?resource_ids=A,B,C returns scoped snapshot + bookings_by_resource. Child bookings appear in BOTH child's list AND parent's list (phantom entry).

legacy_snapshot_endpoint.description: Legacy GET /api/resource-availability-snapshot still works and returns identical snapshot data as hybrid endpoint (no drift).

parent_next_free_max.description: When parent has 2 children both booked at same time, parent's next_free uses MAX(end_at) - so we don't say 'frei ab 22:00' when another sub is still booked until 23:00.

non_splittable_resources.description: Non-splittable resources return snapshot/bookings unchanged (no fake parent/child expansion).

permission_check.description: Only users with view:resources cap can call either endpoint (401/403 for unauthenticated requests).

legacy_availability_only.description: Existing /resource-bookings?availability_only=true list endpoint still works for backwards-compat.

regression_booking_snapshot_sync.description: Create booking → snapshot updates within next request → cancel booking → snapshot reflects.

bookings_list_structure.description: Bookings have required fields (booking_id, resource_id, start_at, end_at, status) and are privacy-safe (no user info).

snapshot_structure.description: Snapshot entries have valid structure (busy_now, next_free if busy, next_busy if not busy).

iter351_regression.description: All 14 iter351 splitable parent room tests pass - backward compatibility confirmed.

iter352_regression.description: All 12 iter352 resource hierarchy refactor tests pass - DRY refactor behavior preserved.

code_review.routes/resources/admin/analytics.py (lin: _compute_availability() is the single source of truth for both snapshot and bookings_by_resource. Uses child_to_parent_map() to fold sub-room bookings into parents. Single Mongo query ensures no drift.
code_review./api/resource-availability (line 229-251: New hybrid endpoint. resource_ids param is optional comma-separated list. When provided, returns scoped snapshot + bookings_by_resource. When omitted, returns global snapshot + empty bookings_by_resource.
code_review./api/resource-availability-snapshot (lin: Legacy endpoint now delegates to _compute_availability(with_bookings=False) - same source of truth as hybrid endpoint.
code_review.services/resource_hierarchy.py: child_to_parent_map() correctly builds {child_id: parent_id} map used by _compute_availability for folding children into parent entries.

critical_code_review_comments: Single Mongo query in _compute_availability() ensures snapshot and bookings_by_resource can never drift - physically impossible
Phantom booking entries correctly added to parent's bookings list when children are booked
MAX(end_at) logic for parent's next_free correctly implemented - uses latest child end time
Legacy /api/resource-availability-snapshot delegates to same _compute_availability() - no code duplication
Privacy-safe bookings list: only booking_id, resource_id, start_at, end_at, status - no user info leaked

success_rate.backend: 100% (42/42 tests passed: 16 iter356 + 14 iter351 + 12 iter352 regression)

seed_data_creation: Test fixture creates fresh bookings on Child A and Child B with different end times (Child B ends 1 hour later) to test MAX(end_at) logic, then cleans up after tests complete.
